title: anim.flight/1
description: data/anim/flight.json: the flight lead (render/anim/anim_fighter.gd, _lead_layer; docs/animation/pose-pipeline.md section 9.23, GB-006): a launched body that has stopped tumbling flies head first along its velocity; a fighter carried fast with his head against the way he goes is stood up to a tilt cap. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Each (from, to) pair rises (checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js, flight-order). Animation's draft: docs/animation/handoff/anim-flight.schema.json.

speed.description: Units a second over which the lead comes in (from, to).

spin.description: The |spin| in rad/s under which the lead comes in (from, to): a tumble spinning faster than `to` is left to tumble.

steep.description: A steep fall (down over across, from, to) is not chased: a landing is upright.

rate.description: 1/s: how fast the turn chases its aim or lets go.

skid_rate.description: 1/s: the same, landing into a skid.

tilt.description: Degrees: the most a fighter carried fast against his head's way is left tilted.

tilt_rate.description: 1/s: the same for the knockback tilt.

lay.description: The sine of the spine's tilt from upright (from, to) over which a pose that lays the body out is flown head first, even in a skid.

pivot_y.description: The body's middle in model space (the view's PIVOT_Y).
